listing.name: Gothic II: Night of the Raven (OpenGothic)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Main quest and addon completable according to upstream; desktop prerelease packages. Limits: Upstream says Gothic II plus Night of the Raven completable; Gothic I is not officially supported. Upstream platforms: Windows DX12/Vulkan, Linux Vulkan and macOS Metal package/build routes documented. Selected package CPU architectures unknown; Windows-only32-bit Union plugins are unsupported. Original data: Gothic I explicitly not officially supported; original Gothic II Night of the Raven files needed. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
